import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected="5dcb550375737c002dbff316121ed1d0c71a27dc"

def run(args):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).strip()
status=run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).strip()
if head!=expected or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected state head={head} status={status!r}")

for rel in ["src/do_again/cli.py","src/do_again/service/runtime.py","src/do_again/browser/runtime.py","tests/test_cli.py","tests/test_service.py"]:
    p=wt/rel
    print(f"=== {rel} ===")
    lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
    needles=[
        "def doctor", "browser_status", "setup_browser", "ensure_browser_running",
        "prepare_runtime", "runtime_layout", "_ensure_control_worktree",
        "_ensure_remote_control_branch", "policy_path", "metadata_path",
        "service_status", "auth_required"
    ]
    hits=[]
    for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
        if any(n.lower() in line.lower() for n in needles):
            hits.append(i)
    seen=set()
    for i in hits[:50]:
        start=max(1,i-8); end=min(len(lines),i+28)
        if any(n in seen for n in range(start,end+1)):
            continue
        seen.update(range(start,end+1))
        print(f"--- {start}-{end} ---")
        for n in range(start,end+1):
            print(f"{n:04d}: {lines[n-1]}")
